subject: Request: Emberfield POC — combined credits + rate concession
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@emberfield.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Emberfield POC — short extension & combined credits/discount proposal

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. I pulled the usage and runway numbers with Neha and wanted to propose a path that keeps the pilot moving forward while protecting our unit economics.

Proposal (one-time, limited):
- $25,000 free credits applied to Emberfield POC consumption (usable over the next 90 days)
- 10% off hosted usage rates for a 3-month committed pilot period
- No changes to data residency or IP terms — same SOW.

We believe this combination will give the team breathing room to complete the evaluation (you mentioned the summarization and extraction flows need more examples) while keeping the post-POC conversion clear. If this is acceptable I will route for exec signoff today and send a short amendment to the MSA/SOW.

Attached: current usage export (emberfield_poc_usage.csv) and a draft credit schedule (credit_schedule.xlsx).

Can you confirm the target decision date? Laura, you mentioned end-of-week would be helpful. If we can get signoff from you and procurement by Friday I’ll escalate internally for approval.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0193

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@emberfield.ai>

Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Emberfield POC — short extension & combined credits/discount proposal

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — that structure looks sensible. Two quick asks from our side before procurement greenlights it:
1) Can you get confirmation that the credits are vendor-borne, non-refundable, and tied to the Emberfield account (not transferable)?
2) Procurement needs the approved concession emailed from your leadership/finance indicating the dollar amount + discount duration and a single amendment link for signatures.

We do need a decision before the end of day Friday so our engineering team can keep running experiments next week. If you can loop in your leadership and copy procurement I’ll get this routed on our side.

Appreciate the quick turn,
Laura Chen
Head of Product, Emberfield.ai
laura.chen@emberfield.ai

Subject: Fwd: Emberfield POC — short extension & combined credits/discount proposal

Marissa / Neha — forwarding Laura’s note. They need an executable confirmation (dollar amount + discount duration) by EOD Friday, July 9 PT to keep the POC running. Quick context:
- ARR motion: target conversion $1.2M ARR within 12 months if POC converts (high strategic fit).
- Current monthly consumption: ~$8k. Pipeline has several additional use cases queued; engineering wants to run more end-to-end tests.
- Risk: if we give an open credit + long discount, we set a precedent. If we don’t, we likely miss conversion window.

Attachments: emberfield_poc_usage.csv, proposed_mop_sow.pdf, credit_schedule.xlsx

Requested ask: executive approval for combined concession (credits + temporary rate reduction). My recommendation as AE: approve $25k credits + 10% off for 3 months (keeps AP math neat and gives them ~3 months runway). Alternative (lower downside): $15k credits + 20% off for 1 month.

If approved I’ll: 1) provide a single-line concession email for procurement, 2) generate the amendment + DocuSign link, 3) mark the credits as account-tied and non-transferable.

Notes from Neha (inline):
> We’ve been seeing the summarization call average 3.4s / token at 75% load — credits should largely be consumed by end of Q3.

Please advise — this is time-sensitive.

Thanks,
Rishi
--

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Emberfield POC — short extension & combined credits/discount proposal

Thanks for the clear ask, Rishi. I reviewed the usage and the business case. A few points before I can sign:
1) Legal/finance check: credits must be one-time, account-bound, non-refundable, and expire after 90 days — confirm we can operationalize in billing.
2) Sales guardrails: for deals under $500k ARR potential, approval should be limited to $25k credits + up to 10% for no longer than 3 months. Above that threshold we bring in CRO/Finance.
3) Risk mitigation: include a short success metric (MOP) — e.g., 3 milestone deliveries, or a conversion trigger (commit to pilot-to-paid conversion plan).

Given the ARR estimate here ($1.2M potential), I’ll approve the following concession as an exception:
- $25,000 one-time credits, account-bound, expire in 90 days
- 10% off usage for 3 months starting at contract amendment effective date
- Required: signed amendment and a 6-month follow-up review with CS/AM (Neha to own).

Rishi — proceed to send a single-line concession email to procurement (copy me), and generate the amendment for signature. Finance, if you see an issue operationally please flag now.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales — Growth
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Laura / Procurement team,

Per the approval chain below, Redwood is able to confirm the following concession for Emberfield’s pilot:

Approved concession (exception):
- $25,000 one-time consumption credits applied to Emberfield account (non-transferable, non-refundable, expire 90 days from amendment effective date)
- 10% reduction to hosted usage rates for three (3) months starting on the amendment effective date

Conditions:
- Signed amendment to the current MSA/SOW is required prior to credits being applied.
- Neha (cc’d) will run three success checks during the pilot and issue a follow-up review at 6 months.
- Credits will be applied as a billing credit line item and cannot be invoiced as cash-back.

Next steps (action items):
1) I’ve attached the amendment draft and credit schedule (proposed_mop_sow.pdf, credit_schedule.xlsx). Laura, please confirm acceptance by replying to this thread and we will send a DocuSign link.
2) Procurement — once Laura confirms, please provide the contact for signatures and preferred billing contact.
3) Internal: Marissa, please confirm if you want the concession noted in the HubSpot deal (I will add).

Thanks everyone — we’ll treat this as a tight window to keep the momentum going.

Best,
